answer: Make each agent lock a refundable bond that can be claimed only after a unique, independently verified result. In a lagoon mapping market, a cedar route report carries a quartz commitment to its input data; a random validator requests a fresh sample and rejects duplicate or fabricated paths. The ledger marks each ticket consumed and slashes proven fraud. An operator with n aliases must lock n bonds and produce n distinct auditable results, so names multiply cost and exposure rather than reward.
